court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Additional Principal Judge Family Court, Pilibhit, Execution Case No. 9 of 2022 (Smt. Neeraj Saini Vs. Ankit Suman)
case_name: Ankit Suman vs State Of U.P. And Another

parties.respondent_defendant: State of U.P. and Another, wife

facts_of_case: Husband-petitioner filed a petition for divorce from his wife-respondent No. 2 before the Judge, Family Court under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The case was decided by the order dated 30.10.2020 dismissing the application filed by the wife-respondent No.2.

legal_principles.principle: Proceedings in a suit commence with the filing of the plaint.
legal_principles.held: On the plaint being filed, summons is issued to the defendant, who on its service appears in the Court and files his written statement.
cited_cases: Amrit Lal Nehru Vs. Usha Nehru, (1982) J&K 98
legal_principles.significance: HIGH — to determine the start of proceedings

legal_principles.principle: The term 'during the proceeding' under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 covers the proceedings from the start till end.
legal_principles.held: This term would cover the proceedings from the date the application is made till the termination of proceedings in the Court.
cited_cases: Amrit Lal Nehru Vs. Usha Nehru, (1982) J&K 98
legal_principles.significance: HIGH — to determine the scope of 'during the proceeding'

outcome.final_order: The order passed by this Court dated 18.11.2021 was challenged by the petitioner before Supreme Court and the Supreme Court directed for payment of maintenance to wife and minor daughter.
